purpose: Teach: しっぽ/のび/安らぎ/染まっ/くっきり/出先/とろ/割る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの愛犬、本気で、絶対、しっぽ、絶対、振って、絶対、翔くんを、絶対、待ってたよ
lines.en: Sho — your tail was wagging so hard the whole time you were waiting for me.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate tone. Speaking to a child with genuine delight. Soft opening, gentle throughout. The voice of someone noticing and naming something the child did without knowing anyone was watching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの家、本気で、絶対、のびのびと、絶対、過ごせるんだよ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、好き
lines.en: Your place just feels so free and easy, Mei-sis. I really love being here.
lines.style: Quiet enthusiasm. A small voice discovering it's safe to say something true out loud. Soft but certain. No performance—just a 6-year-old being honest about how a place makes him feel.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、いる時、絶対、翔くん、絶対、安らぎ、絶対、感じてくれてるみたいで、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: When I'm with you, Sho, it seems like you really do feel peaceful. That makes me so happy.
lines.style: Tender and observant. Speaking half to Sho, half to herself—noticing something she's noticed before and is moved by again. Slow, warm breath. The voice of someone who cares about small truths.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の葉っぱ、本気で、絶対、赤に、絶対、染まったね、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、綺麗
lines.en: The leaves in the park turned such a beautiful red, didn't they, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Bright, observant wonder. A child pointing something out with genuine delight. Quick energy but not loud—the kind of noticing that expects the adult to notice it with him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの写真、本気で、絶対、くっきり、絶対、撮れたわよ、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、上手
lines.en: I got such a clear shot of you today—you came out beautifully in this one.
lines.style: Warm pride in the doing. Speaking to capture a moment and the person in it. Slight lift on the praise—not overdone, but genuine. The pleasure of showing someone you've seen them well.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんから、本気で、絶対、お出先で、絶対、メッセージ、絶対、もらえると、嬉しいよ
lines.en: You know what makes me happy? When you send me a message while I'm out.
lines.style: Soft, earnest directness. A child saying something vulnerable but true. Not asking for reassurance—just naming what matters. Gentle trailing-off at the end, like he's offering it to her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、とろっとした、絶対、プリン、絶対、作ってあげるね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: I'll make you that silky pudding you love—the kind that melts on your tongue.
lines.style: Warm promise. Speaking to what the child wants with gentle certainty. Soft, slow delivery. The voice of someone who has already decided this is happening and is happy about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さんの大事な、絶対、お皿、絶対、割ること、ないように、絶対、気をつけるね、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: I'm going to be really careful with your nice dishes—I promise I won't break anything.
lines.style: Serious responsibility from a small voice. A child making a vow to someone he trusts. Slow, deliberate pace. The kind of promise that matters because he's thought about it.
